name: Site Monitor
description: End-to-end site monitoring with Slack alerting. Daily heartbeat (active-point count + fleet/system summary) plus device/fleet transition alerts (silent, erroring, fleet-wide degradation). Fully config-driven — no site-specific values hardcoded.

options.name: slackWebhookUrl
options.description: Slack Incoming Webhook URL. Leave empty to log alerts instead of sending.

options.name: siteLabel
options.description: Friendly site name shown in messages. Empty = use the NF site name.

options.name: silentMinutes
options.description: A device is 'silent' if it has not reported within this many minutes.

options.name: freshnessHours
options.description: Heartbeat counts a point as active if it got data within this many hours.

options.name: errorRateThreshold
options.description: A device is 'erroring' if its error rate exceeds this (0-1), or status is RED.

options.name: includeYellow
options.description: Treat YELLOW devices as erroring too (more sensitive).

options.name: fleetErrorJump
options.description: Fleet alert when the erroring-device count jumps by at least this many in one interval.

options.name: fleetErrorFraction
options.description: Fleet alert when erroring devices reach this fraction of the fleet (0-1).

options.name: memThresholdPct
options.description: Alert when host memory usage reaches this percent.

options.name: diskThresholdPct
options.description: Alert when host disk usage reaches this percent.

options.name: resourceRealertHours
options.description: While a memory/disk condition persists, re-alert every this many hours.
